chunks: A number of our companions narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Washshāʾ, from al-Khaybarī, from Yūnus ibn Ẓabyān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام), who said:

I heard him say: “Had Allah, Blessed and Exalted, not created Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) for Fāṭimah, there would have been no equal match for her upon the face of the earth, from Ādam and those below him.”

key_terms.آدَمَ: Ādam, the first human being, marking the scope of comparison
key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn, the title of Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام)
key_terms.اللَّهَ: Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, the One who ordained this creation
key_terms.تَبَارَكَ: Blessed; indicating divine exaltedness and abundant goodness
key_terms.تَعَالَى: Exalted is He; indicating Allah’s transcendence
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fāṭimah, the daughter of the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم)
key_terms.كُفْوٌ: An equal, suitable counterpart, or matching peer

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the unique match between Fāṭimah and Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليهما السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith expresses the unique compatibility and singular rank of Fāṭimah and Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليهما السلام). It presents their union as divinely ordained and unmatched among all human beings from Ādam onward.

en.sarwar: 10. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from al-Khaybari from Yunus ibn Zabyan who has said the following. “I heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say, ‘
Had Allah not created Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) for Fatima, there would been no match on earth for her from Adam to the end.”
